items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source: Fetch all records mapped into generic maps.
items.translation: 获取所有映射到通用 Map 的记录。

items.source: The mapping function is responsible to turn one record into one domain object.
items.translation: 映射函数负责将一个记录转换为一个领域对象。
